input.rawHtml: Added to SPY Leaps - now 50 total contracts $38.97 avg
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: old system defaulted to nextFriday(). Fix: LEAP keyword detected → long-dated expiry.

input.rawHtml: Short SPY - added another 10 the leaps - total 60 - avg. $27.67 - 3/26 - $600
input.author: testTrader

cases.description: PCS direction: 'Long GLW pcs 68/67 for .63 credit' — PCS = credit spread = SELL higher/BUY lower PUT

input.rawHtml: Long GLW pcs 68/67 for .63 credit
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: PCS treated as direction=LONG. Fix: PCS = credit spread = legs are SELL higher/BUY lower PUT. 'Long' is stock view not trade direction.

cases.description: CDS with 'next week' expiry hint: 'Long UNH cds for next week expiration'

input.rawHtml: Long UNH cds for next week expiration
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs entirely → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. Fix: orchestrator resolves 'next week' expiry from market data. CDS = call debit spread: BUY lower, SELL higher.

cases.description: Lotto with 'weeklies' expiry: 'Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts' — Lotto = BUY, 'weeklies' must not crash

input.rawHtml: Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts for .15
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: LLM emitted expiry 'weekly' which crashed normalizeExpiry. Lotto = LONG (buy) regardless of Short badge. $95.50 strike.

cases.description: Loss-per-contract exit: 'Exit MSTR for a .11 loss on the lotto' — must CLOSE, not skip

input.rawHtml: Exit MSTR for a .11 loss on the lotto - not enough time left
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug: '.11 loss per contract' was not recognised as a CLOSE and auto-closed at expiry. Fix: Exit badge + symbol + loss context = CLOSE action.

cases.description: 'oct 3 calls' expiry hint: 'Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls'

input.rawHtml: Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. 'oct 3' = October 3rd expiry, orchestrator resolves concrete date.

cases.description: Reversal trade: 'taking the loss on TXN long and shorting it' — must emit CLOSE + OPEN SHORT STOCK, not just one signal

input.rawHtml: Doing a rare reversal trade, taking the loss on TXN long (-$8.40) and shorting it at $199.06 , 1,000 Shares
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Misclassification risk: treating as single CLOSE (missing the short open) or single OPEN (missing the close). 'taking the loss on TXN long' = CLOSE existing long. 'shorting it at $199.06' = OPEN SHORT STOCK. Must produce 2 signals.

cases.description: Exit short stock: 'Exit TXN with $1.74 profit per share' — must CLOSE the short, not skip as commentary

input.rawHtml: Exit TXN with $1.74 profit per share (1,000) - some mitigation against the Long loss
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Misclassification risk: 'mitigation against the Long loss' could confuse LLM into thinking this references the long position. Exit badge + TXN symbol = CLOSE the current SHORT position.

cases.description: 'Long QS via selling the Sept (19) $9.50 puts @ $.50' — coordinated extraction: strike=9.50, premium=0.50, expiry=Sep 19, direction SHORT from 'selling'

input.rawHtml: Long QS via selling the Sept (19) $9.50 puts @ $.50
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: old system had 4 cascading failures: (1) strike regex skipped $9. and captured '50' → strike=50, (2) premium regex captured $9.50 first → premium=9.5, (3) 'selling' not matched by SOLD_RE, (4) 'Sept' not matched by month regex. Fix: coordinated token extraction assigns $9.50+puts=strike, $.50+@=premium, Sept+(19)=expiry. 'selling' added to SOLD_RE.

cases.description: Short badge + lotto puts = BUY, not SELL: 'Short C $96 lotto puts @ $.54 and $.57' (real trade bt:competent-guanaco)

input.rawHtml: Short C $96 lotto puts @ $.54 and $.57
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: Bug: isLotto && hasShortBadge branch set direction=SHORT → SELL leg (naked short put). Fix: lotto is always LONG/BUY. 'Short' badge = bearish stock view, not sell-to-open. Real trade 2f812742 in bt:competent-guanaco lost $160 from this bug.

cases.description: Short badge + lotto puts = BUY: 'Short ABNB Lotto $123 Puts for .21' (real trade bt:competent-guanaco)

input.rawHtml: Short ABNB Lotto $123 Puts for .21 - 40 Contracts
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug: same as regression-014. Short badge + lotto incorrectly set direction=SHORT. Real trade 8b832158 in bt:competent-guanaco.

cases.description: 'put myself back in the AMD position' — English verb 'put' must NOT be classified as PUT option (bt:inland-bandicoot regression)

input.rawHtml: Actually, put myself back in the AMD position... back in at $163.09
input.author: Hariseldon

chatHistory.rawHtml: Exit Short AMD premarket for a $7/share loss
chatHistory.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:inland-bandicoot trade 0dccd5a7 and bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade 9a693233: LLM classified 'put myself back in' as OPEN PUT AMD, then pipeline rejected nonsensical PUT parameters (strike=163.09). Parser correctly guards with PUT_VERB_RE (preventing PUT strategy detection), but LLM ignores this and classifies as PUT. The English verb 'put' (meaning 'place') must not trigger PUT option strategy detection. Fix: LLM prompt now explicitly warns about 'put' as English verb. Without badge or position context, direction cannot be determined — MANUAL_REVIEW is correct.

cases.description: PDS open with no expiry hint — 'Adding to TSLA short with PDS $347.5/$342.5' must not SKIP (bt:inland-bandicoot regression)

input.rawHtml: Short TSLA Adding to my TSLA short with a PDS $347.5/$342.5 for $1.94 - 25 Contracts
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:inland-bandicoot: Parser set expiryHint='-' (no expiry in text), causing open-path to SKIP with 'Could not interpret expiryHint'. This cascaded into closing a STOCK position with the PDS exit signal (trades 02754afe, 46109a5f). Fix: infer nearest weekly expiry from option chain when no hint is provided.

cases.description: PDS exit must NOT close a STOCK position — strategy mismatch guard (bt:inland-bandicoot regression)

input.rawHtml: Exit TSLA PDS with .50 profit per contract (25)
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:inland-bandicoot trade 02754afe: PDS exit signal matched a STOCK SHORT position via fuzzy fallback (only 1 position for TSLA). System closed the stock with a strategyMismatch flag instead of blocking. Fix: STOCK<->spread strategy mismatches must return MANUAL_REVIEW. The PDS was never opened (SKIP'd due to missing expiry — see regression-017).

cases.description: 'Exit NVDA with .86 profit per share (1,000)' — 'per share' must disambiguate STOCK when multiple positions open (bt:inland-bandicoot regression)

input.rawHtml: Exit NVDA with .86 profit per share (1,000)
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:inland-bandicoot trade 6ce30763: When two NVDA positions existed (STOCK long + PUT from post-LEG_OFF PDS), matchPosition returned 'multiple positions found' and SKIPPED. 'per share (1,000)' unambiguously means STOCK. Fix: use 'per share'/'shares' text as a strategy hint to narrow to STOCK positions.

cases.description: 'Offering balance of IREN at $49.40' — 'offering' is a conditional limit sell intent, NOT an executed close (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml: Offering balance of IREN at $49.40. I am expecting at least one more push higher and I will take gains into it.
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade 70ac33f4: 'Offering balance of IREN at $49.40' was LLM-classified as CLOSE, causing premature exit. Real exit at $49.10 (msg 468984) was orphaned. 'Offering' in trading context means 'I have a limit sell placed at this price' — conditional future intent, not an executed trade. Fix: add 'offering' to parser MONITORING_RE for deterministic hard skip.

cases.description: 'Offering COF $165.85. If I hit my target I will make $1.10' — limit sell intention, must SKIP

input.rawHtml: Offering COF $165.85. If I hit my target I will make $1.10 and that will pay for my spread
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: 'Offering COF $165.85' = limit sell placed at that price, not an executed trade. Must be SKIP, not CLOSE.

cases.description: 'I am offering MSTR $.30 above my entry price $312.81' — personal limit sell intention, must SKIP

input.rawHtml: I am offering MSTR $.30 above my entry price $312.81
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: 'I am offering MSTR' = limit sell placed, conditional. Must SKIP.

cases.description: 'BE I am trying to sell for a $1 gain' — future intent, not executed exit (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml: BE I am trying to sell for a $1 gain.
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade f6f0dacb: 'I am trying to sell' was LLM-classified as CLOSE. Real exit (msg 465178 'Exit Long BE $55.20') was orphaned 11 minutes later. 'trying to sell' = future intent, not confirmed exit. Fix: PROSPECTIVE_INTENT_RE catches 'trying to sell/exit/close' for deterministic hard skip.

cases.description: 'looking to sell AAPL here for a quick profit' — prospective intent, must SKIP

input.rawHtml: looking to sell AAPL here for a quick profit
input.author: Pete

cases.notes: 'Looking to sell' = conditional intent, not a fill. Must SKIP.

cases.description: 'Long OSCR added 2,000 more shares' with Long badge + multi-ticker TSLA — must ADD to existing position, not OPEN new one (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml:
Long OSCR added 2,000 more shares ($20.30 avg - 7,000)
Took the hit on TSLA pre-market will probably re-enter at some point for longer term fundamental short
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade b0b0f1bf: 'added 2,000 more shares' with Long badge was classified as OPEN (not ADD) because (1) parser always set OPEN for Long/Short badges, ignoring 'added' verb, and (2) NLU prompt didn't document ADD action. LLM output action=OPEN creating a duplicate OSCR position. Fix: parser checks for 'added/adding' inside badge block → ADD. NLU prompt now includes ADD. Safety net: OPEN→ADD reroute in LLM signal routing.

cases.description: 'Added 500 more shares to OSCR' with no badge — must ADD to existing position (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml: Added 500 more shares to OSCR - 7,500 total - $20.21 avg
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus: 'Added 500 more shares' (no badge) correctly detected as ADD by parser, but failed with 'OPEN signal missing direction for strategy STOCK' because two OSCR positions existed (the duplicate from regression-025). With regression-025 fixed (single position), ADD path enriches direction from matched position and resolves.

cases.description: 'PDS $347.5/$342/5 for $1.94' — slash-for-dot typo: $342/5 must parse as strike 342.5, not [342, 5] (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml: Short TSLA Adding to my TSLA short with a PDS $347.5/$342/5 for $1.94 - 25 Contracts
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade 6ea8df12: '$347.5/$342/5' was tokenized as slash_pair [342, 5] because the $ between / and 342 blocked the intended slash_pair match. Caused QUOTE_FAILED on OCC symbol TSLA 250912P00342000, then marketDataFail flag falsely propagated to the parent STOCK trade. LLM retry eventually corrected to [347.5, 342.5] but wasted tokens and added latency. Fix: (1) slash pair regex accepts optional $ before second number, (2) typo recovery regex detects $A/$B/D pattern where first number has decimal → interprets as $A/$B.D.

cases.description: 'PDS $68/$67' — dollar-prefixed slash pair must parse as strikes [68, 67], not fall through to elimination

input.rawHtml: Long GLW pcs $68/$67 for .63 credit
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Pre-fix the $68/$67 pattern relied on dollar token fallback (rule 12) to assign strikes. With the slash pair regex accepting optional $ before the second number, these are now captured as a proper slash_pair token, which is more robust.

cases.description: 'If I were looking to put a starter position on for IREN' — subjunctive/hypothetical, must SKIP (bt:minimum-hippopotamus regression)

input.rawHtml: If I were looking to put a starter position on for IREN I would sell the Oct (3) $43 put for $1.75. That give me an entry around the EMA 8 if assigned. If not I am going to generate some income. If I am assigned I enter at a good price and I expect to see a bounce off of that level.
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug from bt:minimum-hippopotamus trade 44be2b59: 'If I were looking to' is subjunctive mood — explicitly hypothetical, educational commentary about strategy. Parser extracted strategy=PUT, strikes=[43], expiryHint='oct 3', premiumHint=1.75, but action=null → LLM classified as EXECUTE. The message opens with 'If I were' which is never a real trade. Fix: HYPOTHETICAL_RE detects ^if I were/was and hard-skips when no badge is present.
